hotels.name: TA'AKTANA, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa
hotels.verdict: Brand-new private pool villas, a 24-hour Olympic pool, and truly flawless 24/7 butler care — I genuinely didn't want to leave.
hotels.standout: 5/5 service with dedicated 24/7 butler and brand-new overwater & pool villas
hotels.watchOut: Dining (4/5) sits just a notch below St. Regis Bali and The Sira; shoreline is still maturing

hotels.name: W Maldives
hotels.verdict: Fresh off its major refurbishment with one of the best house reefs in the Maldives and the unforgettable Gaathafushi private island escape.
hotels.standout: Snorkel straight off your villa deck + private 3-hour island castaway excursion
hotels.watchOut: Add a meal plan or Bonvoy breakfast status early — a la carte dining adds up quickly

hotels.name: The Ritz-Carlton, Bali
hotels.verdict: Dramatic 70m cliffside glass elevator, modern Pavilion Pool Villas, and a calmer swimmable beach — at roughly half the price of St. Regis next door.
hotels.standout: Half the price of St. Regis Bali with newer villas and better cliff-to-beach views
hotels.watchOut: Recycled grey-water toilet system can look brown and cause occasional bathroom odors

hotels.name: W Bali — Seminyak
hotels.verdict: Possibly the best-value private pool villa luxury stay in Seminyak, right next to restaurants and shops with a dramatic jungle entrance.
hotels.standout: One-Bedroom Oasis Pool Villas around £400/night + two strong breakfast venues
hotels.watchOut: Skip the Amex portal and book direct for Marriott Bonvoy points; Seminyak waves can be rough

hotels.name: Le Méridien Maldives Resort & Spa
hotels.verdict: Still one of the smartest Marriott Bonvoy points redemptions in the entire Maldives, with stylish modern villas and genuinely warm staff.
hotels.standout: Unbeatable Maldives points-value sweet spot without feeling budget
hotels.watchOut: Seaplane transfer is mandatory and non-negotiable on top of your room rate

hotels.name: Seaside Finolhu Baa Atoll Maldives
hotels.verdict: Home to the longest natural sandbank in the Maldives and the iconic Crab Shack — vibrant, fun, and seriously photogenic.
hotels.standout: 1.8km sandbank walk to the Crab Shack & spacious Ocean Water Villas
hotels.watchOut: Budget carefully for meal plans and seaplane transfers on top of nightly rates

hotels.name: Cocana Resort & Beach Club
hotels.verdict: True modern 5-star resort comfort on Gili Trawangan — private pool villas, heated pool, spa, and Pacifica Beach Club earn a 5/5 for luxury value.
hotels.standout: 5/5 luxury value on Gili T with full resort facilities and private pool villas
hotels.watchOut: More expensive than standard Gili stays, so best if you specifically want full-resort polish

hotels.name: W Algarve
hotels.verdict: An effortless 2.5-hour flight from London with stylish Benagil-inspired design, great terraced pools, and generous Bonvoy Titanium upgrades.
hotels.standout: Supreme Two-Bedroom Suite upgrade worth €2,000+/night & easy UK flight access
hotels.watchOut: A few quirky suite layout details; pricier overall than equivalent luxury in Bali

hotels.name: The Westin Bora Bora Resort & Spa
hotels.verdict: Relaxed, stylish, and honestly more comfortable than the St. Regis next door — plus Marriott points pooling can dramatically slash the cash cost.
hotels.standout: Fresh modern Polynesian design & unbeatable Mount Otemanu lagoon views
hotels.watchOut: Avoid rainy off-peak months and expect steep island food & boat transfer costs

hotels.name: Regent Bali Canggu
hotels.verdict: Flawlessly designed suites and lightning-fast 5/5 service right on Canggu’s beachfront — only held back by limited dining variety (3/5).
hotels.standout: 5/5 hospitality, ultra-fast buggy service, and stunning 1-Bedroom Suites
hotels.watchOut: Menu variety at dining venues (3/5) feels too narrow for a resort of this caliber

hotels.name: The St. Regis Bali Resort
hotels.verdict: Still home to Bali's most legendary breakfast at Boneka and a massive saltwater lagoon — just skip the aging main building and book a villa.
hotels.standout: 5/5 Boneka breakfast (Lobster Omelette!) & 40,000 sq. ft. saltwater lagoon
hotels.watchOut: Older 2008 main-building suites are showing wear; Ritz-Carlton nearby offers better value

hotels.name: The Ungasan Clifftop Resort
hotels.verdict: Perched 100m above the Indian Ocean with intimate villa 'neighborhoods' sharing massive infinity pools and direct access to Sundays Beach Club.
hotels.standout: Relaxed clifftop vibe, cliffside tennis court & private neighborhood pools
hotels.watchOut: Food at Watu and the beach club is decent rather than memorable

hotels.name: Rayavadee Resort
hotels.verdict: A truly one-of-a-kind jungle peninsula resort you can only reach by boat, framed by limestone cliffs and the famous Grotto cave restaurant.
hotels.standout: Boat-only arrival, two-story jungle pavilions & The Grotto beachfront cave dining
hotels.watchOut: Main pool can get busy and parts of the lush grounds could use light freshening up

hotels.name: Four Seasons Resort Koh Samui
hotels.verdict: Iconic 'White Lotus' hillside paradise — extraordinary as a full resort experience, even if the classic villa interiors aren't the newest.
hotels.standout: Jaw-dropping palm-lined hillside views & unmistakable Four Seasons hospitality
hotels.watchOut: Time your visit for Jan–Feb dry season for clear water; rooms feel slightly dated for the price

hotels.name: W Sardinia — Poltu Quatu
hotels.verdict: Super chic, classy Mediterranean design with a private speedboat to the beach club — just aim for shoulder season rather than €1,000/night peak rates.
hotels.standout: Private speedboat beach club transfer & relaxing cabanas around the pool
hotels.watchOut: Peak-season prices (and €18 ice creams) make value tough to justify in midsummer

hotels.name: The Heights Melasti & Sundays Beach Club
hotels.verdict: Sleek modern 2-bedroom private pool villa paired with a reef-kayaking, sunset fire-dance day at Sundays Beach Club — great value Uluwatu combo.
hotels.standout: Modern private pool villa value + effortless food delivery and beach club access
hotels.watchOut: Open-air bathrooms mean you definitely want tropical mosquito repellent packed

hotels.name: Four Seasons Resort Bali at Jimbaran Bay
hotels.verdict: Exceptional 5/5 food, dramatic 50m infinity pool, and warm Four Seasons service — but bare-feeling 30-year-old villas and a pest issue hurt our room score (3/5).
hotels.standout: 5/5 breakfast & restaurant dining + sprawling Coconut Grove & free watersports
hotels.watchOut: Rooms (3/5) feel noticeably older and sparser than newer Bali luxury resorts at £500+
